'''Kal Bedo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] living during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Kal Bedo was born in an unknown period during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Following the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], he began to engage in criminal activity until he was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and formed a gang of other members to join by his side.

Around [[3641 BBY]], Kal received information about him and his members from an unknown person, so he and his men kidnapped Imperial individuals and held them hostage in the [[Maximum Security Section]]. He soon contacted a representative from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and demanded the release of the hostages transport from the planet. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Tark (soldier)|Tark]] agreed to negotiate, but also secretly sent an Imperial operative of the Empire, who managed to free the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], and killed Kal and his subordinates.
